backends.name: Ollama
backends.notes: MVP freeze inference entry; LaunchAgent-managed. Native API allowed only when this backend is active. OpenAI /v1 also available.

backends.name: mlx-lm server
backends.notes: Apple MLX text/coding server via Hugging Face / MLX-community weights. Pair with mlx_vlm when vision is required. Managed venv/launch in P10-T04.

backends.name: MLX-VLM server
backends.notes: Apple MLX vision/multimodal OpenAI-compatible server. Optional second Open WebUI connection for vision split (no custom gateway).

backends.name: LM Studio
backends.notes: Detect-first optional peer. Default app port is 1234; operators may use a detected port. Manage only if a safe documented start path exists (P10-T04).

backends.name: llama.cpp server
backends.notes: GGUF / Metal benchmark and fallback path. Separate artifact lifecycle from the Ollama store. Managed where Agent Lab owns the process.
